claim: CGEL limits which adjectives license the fused construction.
evidence_summary: Main has a ranking interpretation yet fails to license the corresponding fused use.
finding: The inventory needs a lexical restriction alongside the semantic tendency.
inference: Is a ranking interpretation sufficient to license an adjective in a fused construction?

evidence.passage: §9.3, p. 416. CGEL limits which adjectives license the fused construction.
evidence.example: Compare admissible ranking adjectives in §9.3 with main. A speaker who understands which item is principal still cannot freely use the main in the same fused use.
evidence.establishes: CGEL explicitly records this lexical restriction. The semantics predicts a tendency and the inventory supplies an independent control.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
